about: The paper model (model B + tilts without alpha_2, every sigma_v prior width 6 times the exploration ones, on the pessimistic linear-bias prior) when only the cross pairs whose Fingers-of-God-blurred kernels overlap by O_ij >= O_min at the fiducial sigma_v are kept (O_ij = int n_i n_j dz / sqrt(int n_i^2 dz int n_j^2 dz), the blur and overlap() of scripts/make_desi_pairs.py, Gaussian truncated at 4 sigma_z), applied to every listed pair, the DESI-measured ones included; current: every listed pair. Autos always kept; a kept pair keeps its bands; the covariance block of the kept rows is inverted. Per layout and cut: FoM(w0, wa), FoM(Omega_m, 10^9 A_s) and their ratios to current, the cross pairs and cross bands kept, and the sigma_v posterior widths over the paper yaml's prior widths (min, max). pair_overlaps: every listed pair's O_ij (bins from 0). k_max is the z = 0 value of a per-bin cut at k_max/D(zbar_i), computed on the paper fiducial. Written by EXAMPLE_EVALUATE_FISHER_MODEL.ipynb (section 11, item 7, final-tier caches).
